The NXG Cushing Midstream Energy Fund
said on Friday that its name has been changed to The NXG Cushing Energy Infrastructure Fund.

As of December 18, 2026, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in a portfolio of energy infrastructure investments, moving away from midstream energy investments.

As of October 15, 2026, 90% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, consist of energy infrastructure investments, and therefore the fund does not anticipate that any changes in its investment approach or rebalancing of its portfolio will be required in connection with the name and policy change.
SRV will continue to invest no more than 25% of its total assets in securities of energy master limited partnerships that qualify as publicly traded partnerships under the Internal Revenue Code.

title: NXG Cushing Midstream Energy Fund to change name and broaden investment policy to energy infrastructure
